note: Frozen before meta-training. The five-statistic CAN-bus combination used in the 2x2 oracle was assembled after the fact; this file exists so the definition cannot drift to fit a result. Any change requires a version bump and a re-run of the correlation check.

inputs.source: camera-to-world poses of the frames preceding the current chunk
inputs.causality: Only frames strictly before the chunk being adapted to. Nothing derived from the adaptation itself -- a TTT residual would not exist at retrieval time and would make the key self-referential.
inputs.gauge: Every feature is a frame-to-frame difference. Absolute pose is forbidden: streaming reconstruction drifts, so keying retrieval on world coordinates is circular.

statistics.name: speed_mean
statistics.definition: mean over the window of ||t_i - t_{i-1}|| * fps

statistics.name: speed_sd
statistics.definition: standard deviation of the same per-step speeds

statistics.name: yaw_mean
statistics.definition: mean over the window of angle(R_i R_{i-1}^T) * fps

statistics.name: yaw_sd
statistics.definition: standard deviation of the same per-step rotation rates

statistics.name: still_frac
statistics.definition: fraction of steps whose speed is below still_threshold

statistics.name: dir_consistency
statistics.definition: mean cosine between consecutive normalised translation directions; 1 for a straight run, near 0 for erratic motion

statistics.name: arc_over_net
statistics.definition: sum of per-step distances divided by the straight-line distance between the first and last camera; 1 for a straight run, larger for turns and loops

standardisation: Running mean and variance collected during training and frozen with the bank. A scale that keeps shifting would make stored keys mean different things at different times.

excluded.can_bus: Vehicle telemetry adds nothing once pose is controlled for (own contribution -0.038, p=0.29, over 756 pairs) and would restrict the method to driving data.
excluded.spatial_proximity: Distance between two segments does not predict whether their adaptations are interchangeable (rho = +0.021, p = 0.56). This negative result is what the retrieval design rests on.

open_checks.estimated_pose_from_the_model: The robustness test injected isotropic per-step odometry error and the correlation held (82% retained at 10 cm / 1 deg per frame). Real pose error is not isotropic: it is largest during fast turns, which is exactly where the descriptor's own value changes most, so the error may correlate with the quantity being measured. Re-check once the model estimates its own poses, not before.
open_checks.held_out_scenes: Confirm rho on 30 scenes never used to build the descriptor.
